mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; venlafaxine inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine while isocarboxazid inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
action: Contraindicated combination; allow minimum 14 days washout of isocarboxazid before starting venlafaxine, or 7 days washout of venlafaxine before starting isocarboxazid; monitor closely if transition is unavoidable.
